Getting Around

Near Al Rigga Metro

Good to Know

Questions & House Rules

Is the whole place private?

Yes. It is an entire rental unit with 1 bedroom, 2 beds and 2 baths, listed for 1 guest.

What do I need at check-in?

Dubai holiday homes register their guests, so expect to share your passport or ID and contact details in advance. Confirm the exact steps with the host.

Are there any extra fees?

Dubai may apply a Tourism Dirham charge. Exact pricing, including any fees, is shown on Airbnb once you add your dates.

How do I book?

Choose your dates in the booking card and continue to the Airbnb listing.
